text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I lost,
Trainer... I can't believe I let you
see me
looking so lame.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But losin' all the time just doesn't suit
how cool I
strive to be!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure I get first place next
time!
I'll throw
down some speed no one can
keep up with!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to keep your eyes wide open
so you
don't miss a moment of my glory!
